sig: [[["A", "Hi, I'm calling from Brightline Software. We're celebrating our tenth anniversary on the twelfth of June, and we need catering."], ["B", "Congratulations! How many guests are you expecting?"], ["A", "We've invited a hundred and fifty, but we're planning for about a hundred and twenty."], ["B", "OK. Our buffet package is thirty-two dollars a head, and that includes drinks."], ["A", "Does it cover vegetarian options? About a third of our staff don't eat meat."], ["B", "Yes, and we can do vegan and gluten-free on request at no extra charge."], ["A", "Great. What about a cake? I'd like one with our logo on it."], ["B", "We can do that, but custom cakes need two weeks' notice, so we'd need the design by the twenty-ninth of May."], ["A", "That's cutting it close. Our designer's away until the twenty-fifth."], ["B", "That still leaves a few days. I'll email you a quote today, and a twenty percent deposit will lock in the date."]], {"A": "M-US", "B": "F-AU"}]
